name: Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
what_you_do: A paid summer job for 8 weeks with a government office, library, nonprofit or business. You first get 3 days of job skills training.
who_can_apply: Broward County students ages 16 to 18. You must be able to work in the US and have a valid ID. Your family must meet the income rule. Teens are picked by income, the date they apply and a lottery.
pay_detail: $15 per hour, about 30 hours a week
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 open Dec 1, 2026 at 9 am. No closing date is posted. Picks are done by March 2027. The program runs June 7 to Aug 3, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the window opens. Income, how early you apply and a random lottery decide who gets in. Chosen youth get a packet by mail and go to training.
notes: Funded mainly by the Children's Services Council of Broward County. Remote work is not offered. You can apply at 15 if you turn 16 by June 7, 2027. If picked, you and a parent go to an in-person interview with original papers, including your Social Security card.
